name: Marduk
title: Calf of the Sun
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: King of Ekur’s gods, Marduk was always a deity of war and of wrath, but always in the service of protecting his world. That wrath has burned unabated since the Shattering, and the obvious cause—the violation of the natural order—can explain only some of it. He schemes with gods of other Realms toward objectives he thus far will not share.

Also place [Phoenix] on each ally for 2 turns which cannot be removed.
If this passive activates this hero’s Core Ability, increase this hero’s Divinity by 100%.
